title: Hala'ib Triangle
description: UN Geodata 2023 draws this area inside Sudan. GAUL keeps it as its own entity, xHT. It is cut out along the UN line, and the islands off its coast go with it.

title: Bir Tawil
description: UN Geodata 2023 draws this area inside Egypt. GAUL keeps it as its own entity, xMS. It is cut out along the UN line.

title: Ilemi Triangle
description: UN Geodata 2023 draws this area inside South Sudan. GAUL keeps it as its own entity, xIT. It is cut out along the UN line.

title: India-China disputed areas (xxx)
description: GAUL has one entity, xxx, made of four areas along the India-China line. UN Geodata 2023 has no lines for them and divides each between China, India, and Jammu and Kashmir. GAUL's outlines are the cuts, and each area stays separate on each side of the UN line.

title: India-China line between Nepal and Bhutan
description: GAUL and UN Geodata 2023 draw this stretch of the India-China line differently. The area between the two versions is its own unit, belonging to China in the UN export and India in the GAUL export.
method: GAUL line as cut line, ends joined to the UN boundary

title: Kuril Islands in the Russian Federation
description: UN Geodata 2023 places the southern Kuril Islands in xRI and the rest in the Russian Federation. The rest take UN Geodata's own disputed code, xRI.

title: Kuril Islands
description: GAUL has one entity, xKI, which matches UN Geodata's disputed code xRI once C14 is applied. Whole islands are attributed to xKI, and the UN keys are kept.

title: Bassas da India
description: GAUL has these islands as their own entity. UN Geodata 2023 includes them in the French Southern Territories.

title: Europa Island
description: GAUL has this island as its own entity. UN Geodata 2023 includes it in the French Southern Territories.

title: Glorioso Islands
description: GAUL has these islands as their own entity. UN Geodata 2023 includes them in the French Southern Territories.

title: Juan de Nova Island
description: GAUL has this island as its own entity. UN Geodata 2023 includes it in the French Southern Territories.

title: Tromelin Island
description: GAUL has this island as its own entity. UN Geodata 2023 includes it in the French Southern Territories.

title: Chagos Archipelago
description: GAUL has its own entity, IOT. UN Geodata 2023 includes these islands in Mauritius.

title: Ashmore and Cartier Islands
description: GAUL has its own entity. UN Geodata 2023 includes these islands in Australia.

title: Clipperton Island
description: GAUL has its own entity. UN Geodata 2023 includes this island in French Polynesia.

title: Akrotiri
description: GAUL has this area as its own entity. UN Geodata 2023 has one row, xUK, with both Akrotiri and Dekelia.

title: Dekelia
description: GAUL has this area as its own entity. UN Geodata 2023 has one row, xUK, with both Akrotiri and Dekelia.

title: Northern Ireland
description: UN Geodata 2023 has a separate row for Northern Ireland. GAUL has one United Kingdom entity, so both UN rows map to it.

title: Paracel Islands
description: GAUL's Viet Nam entity includes these islands in the South China Sea. UN Geodata 2023's Paracel Islands stay in xPI.

title: Spratly Islands
description: GAUL's Viet Nam entity includes these islands in the South China Sea. UN Geodata 2023's Spratly Islands stay in xSI.

title: Viet Nam islands not carried over
description: GAUL's Viet Nam entity includes these polygons in the South China Sea. They have no UN land, so they are recorded as removed.
